notes.title: THE TITJOB UPDATE IS HERE!
notes.notes:
We have exciting news for you all, in this first update we have addressed some animation issues, making them smoother and feeling better.

And on top of that we added a brand new pose to all the game scenes, the titjob!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981955/3b4f2d1078d8bf9deb3aab6a5cea460ff1c6ac27.gif

We're working hard to bring you new features and content on a regular basis, so keep your eyes open and don't miss out!
